name: Snowball (Kobold Press/Open Design)
body:
School transmutation [cold]; Level druid/shaman 0, sorcerer/wizard 0

CASTING

Casting Time 1 swift action
Components S, M (handful of snow)

EFFECT

Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw none (harmless); Spell Resistance no (harmless)

DESCRIPTION

You instantly sculpt a handful of snow into a snowball that’s perfectly suited for throwing in a line up to 30 ft. long. The snowball inflicts 1d3 nonlethal damage (1d2 for Small characters) and has a +1 masterwork bonus to hit, but otherwise counts as a non-magical attack.
